CustomField.inlineHelpText: If the client has agreed to not contest an unemployment claim by the WSEE, please notify an unemployment specialist. Please remember to enter SEPARATION AGREEMENT – NO PROTEST into the subject line. Please include: Client Name, WSEE Name, and WSEE ID# in the body of the email. If a multi-person layoff, email unemployment specialist with a spreadsheet identifying all employees and the subject line should read: SEPARATION AGREEMENT – NO PROTEST.
CustomField.label: Do not contest unemployment
